html: The Caldwell First Nation is an Anishinaabe community of south-western Ontario, on the north shore of Lake Erie around Point Pelee and Pelee Island. Its people come from the Ojibwe, Odawa and Potawatomi, the Three Fires of the Anishinaabe. They fought beside the British in the War of 1812 but afterwards lost their land to settlers, and for some two centuries had no reserve. After a long land claim, they reached a settlement with Canada in 2010 and later gained reserve land near Leamington.
